title: album-studio intake brief
description: Form payload exported by site/intake.html. Read by the music-album-planning-questionnaire skill to write a CONCEPT-BRIEF.md.

albumSlug.description: URL-safe album identifier, derived from artist name + date (e.g. 'maren-sol-half-light-hours-2026-06-25')

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of form export

answers.description: Map of M·01..E·21 question IDs to answer objects

M08_bandName.title: Band name
M08_bandName.description: The performing band's name. Filled ONLY when the release is by a band (a group of people credited under one name). Leave EMPTY if the release is by a solo artist whose name is the public identity (e.g. 'Maren Sol' has no band name — that goes in M08_artistName instead). Optional.
M08_bandName.x-tier: Mandatory (delta-added 2026-08-02 per META-DECISIONS §1 / walks with M08)
M08_bandName.x-locked: Locked 2026-08-02 §1.M08a (replaced M08c triple-choice per Shape B)
M08_bandName.x-optional-when: Release is NOT a band (i.e. solo artist)
M08_bandName.x-prompt: If this release is by a band (a group of people), put the band name here. If it's a solo artist, leave this blank.

M08_artistName.title: Public-facing artist name
M08_artistName.description: The artist name shown to listeners. ALWAYS FILLED — every release has at least one artist name. For a solo release, this is the solo artist's name. For a band release, this is either (a) the front person's name if they're separately credited, or (b) the same as M08_bandName if the band is the only public identity.
M08_artistName.x-tier: Mandatory (delta-added 2026-08-02 per META-DECISIONS §1 / walks with M08)
M08_artistName.x-locked: Locked 2026-08-02 §1.M08b (replaced M08c triple-choice per Shape B)
M08_artistName.x-prompt: For a solo release: your artist name (e.g. 'Maren Sol'). For a band release: the front person's name OR the same as M08_bandName if the band is the only public identity.

M08_creditLine.title: Credit line (optional)
M08_creditLine.description: Free-form 'presented as...' / 'a side project of...' / 'performing name of...' line that goes on the release. Optional. Used by ID3 album artist field when M08_bandName and M08_artistName are both filled and you want a third name in the credits.
M08_creditLine.x-tier: Mandatory (delta-added 2026-08-02 per META-DECISIONS §1 / walks with M08)
M08_creditLine.x-locked: Locked 2026-08-02 §1.M08c (replaced M08c triple-choice per Shape B — now an OPTIONAL text, not an enum)

R15_loudnessTarget.title: Mastering loudness target
R15_loudnessTarget.description: Streaming/integrator target. Sets the master stage on finalize. Default: spotify (-14 LUFS).
R15_loudnessTarget.x-prompt: Where will this album mostly be played? This sets the master loudness.

R16_sequencePacing.title: Album sequence & pacing
R16_sequencePacing.x-prompt: How much silence between tracks? Affects gapless playback vs mixtape feel.

defaults.description: Map of question IDs to true if the user accepted an agent default instead of answering

skipped.description: List of question IDs the user chose not to answer (Recommended or Extra tier only)

v2_0_changes_2026_08_02.summary: v2.0 bump: R15 (loudness target) + R16 (sequence pacing) + M08c_artistKind (real/fictional/alter-ego/pseudonym). SUPERSEDED by v2.1 — see below.

v2_1_changes_2026_08_02_shapeB.summary: v2.1 bump: removed M08c_artistKind (4-option enum: real-self / fictional-character / alter-ego / collaborative-pseudonym) and old M08_artist single-text field. New shape: M08_bandName (optional text, optional-when M08_artistName filled) + M08_artistName (optional text, optional-when M08_bandName filled) + M08_creditLine (optional text, optional). Per user direction 2026-08-02: 'you can have the band name but you can also have the artist name that is presented to the public, or both, that can happen as well. however, i dont want multiple artist names (fictional, real, alterego, etc).' User picked Shape B (M08_bandName + M08_artistName + optional credit line) over Shape A (free text) and Shape C (member roster). REVISION r2 (2026-08-02 same session): clarified M08_artistName is required (x-required: true) and M08_bandName is optional (x-optional: true). Per user direction: artist name is always present, band name is only filled for band releases (Maren Sol pattern = artist name only). Annotation-only revision, no field-shape changes — no schema major bump per Q45.
v2_1_changes_2026_08_02_shapeB.bump_reason: Schema v2.0 → v2.1 / form 2026-08-02 → 2026-08-02-shapeB (Q45: removing a Mandatory enum counts as a major bump)
